name: Baminea
source:
Baminea (full name is Baminea Om'Taligense) – is a character in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change.
A blue blue-eyed om'verai with white claws and dark-blue belly plates. Baminea's head is decorated with a dark-blue fin and thin black spikes, cheecks have whiskers.
Curious and easy-going, Baminea likes travelling and learning about recent events, as well as is interested in annors.
